reviews.name: 주****
reviews.content: 저희 애가 너무나 사랑하는 할로윈 시리즈 장난감이에요! 작년 할로윈 공도 너무나 사랑해서 여태 가지고 놀고있는데 새로나온 장난감이라뇨! 다 가지고 놀고싶고 안뺏기려고 열심히 장난감 사수하는 모습이 너뮤 귀여워요ㅋㅋ공 사랑하는 강쥐들에게 장난감 강추합니닷!!
reviews.content_en: Our pup absolutely loves the Halloween series toys! She loved last year's Halloween ball so much that she's still playing with it, and now there's a new toy out?! She wants to play with all of them and is so adorably protective, trying hard not to let anyone take her toys away ㅋㅋ I highly recommend these toys for dogs who love balls!!
